#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;
    
    int result = 1;
    
    while (m != 0) {
        int remainder = m % w;
        if (remainder == w - 1 && remainder != 1) {
            m = (m + 1) / w;
        } else if (remainder == 1) {
            m = m / w;
        } else if (remainder != 0) {
            result = 0;
            break;
        } else {
            m = m / w;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << (result == 1 ? "YES" : "NO");
    
    return 0;
}
